# Internet Archive Wayback Machine

> > A digital archive preserving billions of web pages across time, capturing the evolution of the internet from early pioneers like Google and YouTube to countless other websites.

The Wayback Machine is the Internet Archive's flagship service, allowing users to browse historical snapshots of websites dating back to the 1990s. It serves as an essential tool for researchers, historians, and anyone interested in exploring how the web has evolved over decades.

## Key Topics

- Internet Archive
- Historical web snapshots
- Web archiving

## Historic Tech Company Origins

- [Welcome to Google](https://web.archive.org/web/19981111184551/http://google.com/): 1998 archived snapshot of Google's early homepage at google.com
- [Google! Search Engine](https://web.archive.org/web/19981111183552/http://google.stanford.edu/): 1998 archived Google search engine at Stanford University domain
- [YouTube - Broadcast Yourself.](https://web.archive.org/web/20050428014715/http://www.youtube.com/): 2005 archived snapshot of YouTube's early homepage with user registration

## Entertainment and Media Sites

- [iCarly.com](https://web.archive.org/web/20080213034600/http://icarly.com/): 2008 archived iCarly fan site with polls, fan art, and video submissions

## Optional

- [Welcome to www.wearelittlestars.com](https://web.archive.org/web/20020331023129/http://wearelittlestars.com/): 2002 archived landing page for wearelittlestars.com website
